Contract CT-24a adminGetDashboard (planned; backend B1-34 not done, developed against the contract with a fake server); visuals per the finalized spec design/specs/admin-dashboard.md. Frozen admin-shell / admin-antd / admin-auth / admin-auth-qr cases synced (ruling D10-92 B': structure split first by test-changes F1-06zm #954 and F1-06zn #963, then only the super-admin case bodies and MENU#2 / MENU#5 changed); one red_exempt (layout admin-home-no-perm, #964) confirmed by the rule-test reviewer. Rule tests by Codex in three calls plus a mechanical replay after the rebase (not counted), Claude spec-test review r2 pass and r3 quick re-check pass, red on the test machine (red/6: 47 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in one round; test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/3 green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.
